items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I took Barry Galbraith, a great guitar player, and Bill, put them in the car

ctx.x: You – if I’m not mistaken, when Miles was looking for a piano player, you recommended Bill to him, didn’t you?
Yes I did. I took Barry Galbraith, a great guitar player, and Bill, put them in the car, a – those German cars. What were they called? Little small cars. We went over . . .
